context.body: Solomonic royal and Temple claims become a prayer of dependence.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: The prayer recalls creation and human rule, confesses weakness, asks wisdom to come from God’s throne, and links salvation to divine counsel.
observations.label: The speaker asks wisdom to share the throne: action

observations.body: The chosen builder of a Temple confesses that even a complete human is nothing without wisdom.
observations.label: The speaker asks wisdom to share the throne: response

observations.body: God of my fathers · wisdom beside your throne · build a temple · saved
observations.label: Words in Wisdom 9:1–18

payload.posture: Read Wisdom 9:1–18 as works bearing solomon’s name evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The prayer speaks in Solomon’s literary persona while its canonical reception extends beyond one historical moment.
payload.title: The speaker asks wisdom to share the throne
